semiconductor_relevance: High — Okmetic is a leading supplier of advanced silicon wafers, which are critical substrates in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Okmetic specializes in the supply of advanced silicon wafers, focusing on high value-added products for semiconductor applications. Their extensive portfolio includes 150 to 200 mm wafers, such as High Resistivity RFSi® wafers, polished wafers, and bonded Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) wafers, which are essential for MEMS, sensors, RF, and power devices.
capabilities: Bonded Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) wafers with and without cavities

regional_presence.Finland: Headquartered in Finland, where the majority of its silicon wafer production takes place.
